message: No detected input validation: The URL and comment count are taken directly from user input and passed to the extractor without any format validation, type checks, or range guards beyond Streamlit's number_input widget.

No detected untrusted source handling: The code authenticates to the YouTube API via OAuth but performs no integrity verification (checksums, pinned API versions beyond the string 'v3', or signature checks) on the fetched comment data.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label distributions, checks label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation code only scrapes and lightly filters comments (stopwords, URL removal) with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering against poisoning.
No detected model integrity verification: The model is loaded directly with `dill.load(open('fittedWinnerModel', 'rb'))` without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision check.

No detected label distribution validation: The code loads a pre-fitted model with dill and runs inference/analysis; there is no validation of label distribution or class balance check before any training step.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor or trigger detection mechanisms (e.g., Neural Cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection) are present anywhere in the code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries or mechanisms (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) are imported or used in any part of the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks or attack simulations (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While Helper.py computes multiple metrics (precision, recall, F1, Fbeta, accuracy, ROC-AUC), there is no evidence of a held-out test set isolation strategy, signed/hashed evaluation data, or other controls to prevent metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The YouTube URL and comment count are taken directly from user input via st.text_input/st.number_input with no validation of URL format, range checks on comment count, or schema enforcement before being passed to the extraction and model pipeline.

No detected output bounds checks: The code loads and uses the dill-deserialized model (fittedWinnerModel) for inference with no visible checks on output probabilities, NaN guards, or sanity bounds on predictions before displaying results.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a classical ML spam/sentiment classifier (not an LLM), so prompt injection is not directly applicable; no input filtering or content moderation against adversarial text manipulation is implemented either.
